reason: Reviewed the existing harness integration evidence and the changed setup, readiness, skill and README surfaces. Unattended init starts the same bounded trusted browser approval as interactive setup, reports progress on stderr and final readiness on stdout, and preserves the access errand when approval stops. Transient lookups require retry rather than reapproval; selecting a Companion platform starts one bounded handoff. The skill now names init as the approval owner. Lifecycle activation and Question Routing remain unchanged, User browser approval remains required, and domain terms distinguish Account access, machine approval and Companion readiness.
